description: A React component for rendering a Big Number visualization with optional trendline, including dynamic font sizing, conditional rendering, and styling. It integrates with Apache Superset UI components and formats numerical and timestamp data.

classes.name: BigNumberVis
classes.description: React functional component for Big Number visualization with styling and dynamic content rendering.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Generates the CSS class name string based on component props.

methods.name: createTemporaryContainer
methods.description: Creates an off-screen DOM element for measuring text size.

methods.name: renderFallbackWarning
methods.description: Renders a warning message if data is outdated or unavailable.

methods.name: renderMetricName
methods.description: Renders the main metric name with dynamically computed font size.

methods.name: renderKicker
methods.description: Renders timestamp or kicker text with dynamic font sizing.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the main number with color formatting and context menu handling.

methods.name: rendermetricComparisonSummary
methods.description: Renders subheader or comparison summary with dynamic font size.

methods.name: renderSubtitle
methods.description: Renders subtitle or fallback messages with dynamic font size.

methods.name: renderTrendline
methods.description: Renders trendline chart if data is available.

methods.name: getTotalElementsHeight
methods.description: Calculates total height of text elements for overflow handling.

methods.name: shouldApplyOverflow
methods.description: Determines if overflow styling should be applied based on content height.
